evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Current evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) report performance at the dataset or task level, revealing what a model achieves but offering little insight into the internal processing associated with its performance.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate 16 LLMs across 24 diverse benchmarks and conduct targeted internal-state analyses on representative models and tasks, observing systematic differences in processing between knowledge-centric and reasoning-centric tasks.
